if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth > innerWidth) throw new Error('Page overflows horizontally'); true
if(!document.querySelector('#detail-description').textContent.includes('accession')) throw new Error('Molecular details missing'); true
if(window.__tasterDiagram.getState().selected !== 'representation' || document.activeElement.dataset.stage !== 'representation') throw new Error('Keyboard stage navigation failed'); true

document.querySelector('#trace-mode').value='forward'; document.querySelector('#trace-mode').dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); if(window.__tasterDiagram.getState().traced.edges.join(',') !== 'verify-deliver') throw new Error('Trace follows unauthored path'); true
if(window.__tasterDiagram.getState().zoom <= 1) throw new Error('Zoom failed'); true
const view = window.__tasterDiagram.getState(); if(view.zoom!==1 || view.x!==0 || view.y!==0) throw new Error('Fit did not reset'); true

(async()=>{const source=await window.__tasterDiagram.exportSVG(); const doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(source,'image/svg+xml'); if(doc.querySelector('parsererror') || doc.querySelectorAll('[data-stage]').length!==6 || !source.includes('data:font/ttf;base64,') || doc.querySelector('[aria-pressed]')) throw new Error('SVG export failed'); return ({exportBytes:source.length,nodes:doc.querySelectorAll('[data-stage]').length})})()
if(!document.querySelector('#next-stage').disabled || !document.querySelector('#detail-description').textContent.includes('render command')) throw new Error('Video endpoint details failed'); true
